title: Mind & Matter: Holistic Health Talks
description: Thrive Talks is the seminar segment of the Holistic Health Hack - Bringing together professionals, researchers, and passionate students for conversations that bridge science, wellbeing, and innovation. Hear real experiences and insights that inspire new ways to think about health - and how we can all thrive together.
content:
Join us this Saturday at the CC Theatre to learn from professionals in the medical field & passionate student speakers!

There will also be club booths and workshops in the CC foyer!! Feel free to also visit hackathon participants' booths and listen to their presentations! Don't miss out!
